sentences: An Army unit in Georgia offered a four-day pass, timed to the launch.
The catch? Sign up for at least two more years.
Almost one in five full-time workers plan to skip launch day.
Half the gamers taking off? [whispers] They'll call in sick.
People are calling it... the GTA flu.
One tech company gave seven thousand employees a day off to game.
So be honest... [laughs] are YOU catching the GTA flu?
